title: Sum the good rows and log every bad one

blocks.text: Never leave a catch block empty: at the very least, record what went wrong.

Write `BatchImporter.sum(List<String> rows, List<String> log)`. It parses every row as an `int` and returns the sum of the rows that parse. A row that does not parse is skipped, and one line is added to `log` for it: `"row <n>: <message>"`, where `<n>` counts rows from 1 and `<message>` is the message of the exception `Integer.parseInt` threw.
Every kind of bad row goes to the log, including one that is not there at all.

cases.says: It sums rows that are all numbers and logs nothing.
A bad row is skipped and logged with its row number and the exception's message; an empty catch hides it.
A null row is logged like any other bad row instead of crashing the import.
